issue_context.title: REGR: inplace arithmetic operation on Series no longer updating parent DataFrame
issue_context.body:
- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the latest version of pandas.

- [X] (optional) I have confirmed this bug exists on the master branch of pandas.

---

**Note**: Please read [this guide](https://matthewrocklin.com/blog/work/2018/02/28/minimal-bug-reports) detailing how to provide the necessary information for us to reproduce your bug.

#### Code Sample, a copy-pastable example

```python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"A": [1, 2, 3]})

a = df["A"]
a += 999

print(df)
print(df["A"])

assert a is df["A"]
```

#### Problem description

I expect `print(df)` and `print(df["A"])` to show identical values for column `A`.  This is not the case.  The output of the code above:
```
   A
0  1
1  2
2  3
0    1000
1    1001
2    1002
Name: A, dtype: int64
```

#### Expected Output
```
   A
0  1000
1  1001
2  1002
0    1000
1    1001
2    1002
Name: A, dtype: int64
```
